title: Sealed cluster-aware hold-out evaluation of the main systems

sealed.unit: charging_station_id cluster (no cluster straddles the boundary)
sealed.used_for: final scoring only; never for fitting, tuning, early stopping, thresholding or calibration

training.tcn_schedule: cosine, fixed; no validation-based checkpoint selection
training.meta: L2 logistic regression, C selected on in-training OOF only
training.hgb_params: frozen E08 selected_params per seed and budget; not retuned on the new rows

notes: The historical test split is not read; the sealed set replaces it for this audit.
Reusing E08 hyper-parameters is deliberate: no new tuning is performed on the new rows.
Sealed rows come from the same distribution; this responds to selection leakage, not to distribution shift.
All three branches are refitted from scratch on the new partition.
